reason: We already have the plan for the new market and nobody on my team has time to open it, so a free sample of 15 targets and only EUR 1,500 at risk is easy to say yes to. I would take the sample first, and if those 15 companies are the right ones I would sign.
objection: Whether they really understand our niche. Plenty of agencies can pull a list off LinkedIn, but in our trade the buyer is often not the obvious title, and meetings with the wrong people waste my time even if they count as 'qualified'.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15-company sample shows names that do not fit our niche, or the reference client turns out to be in a completely different trade, I walk away.
